title: Voltara's reactors overflow
text: Voltara's reactors ran past quota and kept running. Nobody ordered the surplus, so energy there is cheap now, and the reactors hum louder, pleased with themselves. Buy while the Plan argues about it.

title: Grey blight on Tillam's terraces
text: A grey blight is eating Tillam's terraces. Leaves come apart like wet paper. Food there is dear now and pays well. The committee will study the blight. The blight will not wait for the committee.

title: Ashgate's harvest comes in heavy
text: Ashgate brought in more than the Plan allowed for. Food there is cheap to buy and pays little to sell. A surplus is a gift to the Commons. A surplus that nobody moves is a loss, and someone has to move it.

title: Voltara's crews go hungry
text: Voltara's crews are on long shifts and short rations. Less food arrived than was counted. Food there costs more and pays more. The Bureau cut every ration by the same amount, which it calls fair. Hungry people call it hunger.

title: Frost on Tillam
text: Winter came early to Tillam. The heaters run day and night, so energy there costs more and pays more. Frost has begun to grow inside the ducts, in patterns no one has agreed to explain. Someone must keep the lights on.

title: Ashgate lights every furnace
text: Ashgate restarted every foundry at once to meet a plan that arrived this morning. Energy there costs more and pays more. The furnaces glare through the smoke. Nobody asked where the energy comes from. Someone with a ship will carry it.

title: Tillam's docks go on strike
text: The dock crews of Tillam walked out, and the committee calls it a misunderstanding. The port is closed for a while. Routes touching Tillam are blocked until it reopens. The ships wait outside, and they do not take sides.

title: Ashgate seals its port
text: Something was found in Ashgate's lower docks, and the doctors will say only that the port is closed. It reopens when they say so. Routes touching Ashgate are blocked until then. Caution is shared equally, and so is the fear.

title: Voltara goes dark
text: A fault in Voltara's grid took the port down with it. The planet that powers everyone cannot keep its own lights on. Closed for a while. Routes touching Voltara are blocked until it reopens. The Plan will be revised, backwards.

title: A lender walks Tillam's market
text: A lender's agent walked Tillam's market and bought up every debt in sight. Sellers settled what they owed and sold what they had. Energy there costs less and pays less for now. Even a society that owns everything together can find a way to owe.

title: Ashgate's foreman says enough
text: An Ashgate foreman looked at the numbers, declared the shift had made enough, and sent the crews home. Energy there costs less and pays less. Enough is a figure the Plan does not print. The word moved through the docks faster than any form.

title: Voltara buys before the news
text: Word from the other systems arrives late, and Voltara's buyers would not wait for it. They bought, so energy there costs more and pays more. Out past the beacons the dark is patient. It is the one thing nobody has been asked to share.

title: A family buys Ashgate's food
text: A family with old credits quietly bought up Ashgate's food contracts, all of them. Food there costs more and pays more. The Commons owns everything together, and here is a part still for sale. You are in no position to judge.

title: The inspector's count
text: An inspector counted Voltara's food stores and found them sufficient, on a form. The market believed the form, so food there costs less and pays less. The crews are still hungry, now correctly accounted for.

title: Tillam's festival of founders
text: Tillam declared a festival to honour its founders. Three committees claim to be them. Food there costs more and pays more. Everyone agrees on the feast. Nobody agrees who is hosting, so everyone is, and nobody is clearing the tables.

title: A ship leaves Tillam half empty
text: A ship left Tillam half empty, bound for a rock nobody has charted. The people who stayed sold their spare food to pay for staying. Food there costs less and pays less. The departure form was filed in advance. The return form was not.
